mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia can lower seizure threshold and reduce levetiracetam efficacy, while levetiracetam may increase risk of hyponatremia through SIADH.
action: Monitor electrolytes (sodium, potassium) regularly; consider potassium supplementation or alternative antihypertensive if hypokalemia develops; assess seizure control.
